title: Connected geometric fibres force compatibility of inverse-image sections
statement: Let f:T\to S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] whose geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre] are connected [def-weil-connected-scheme]. Let F be a sheaf of sets on the small etale site of S [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] and let a be a global section of f^{-1}F. Put D=T\times_S T [def-pc-fibre-product], with projections p_1,p_2. The sections p_1^*a and p_2^*a of (f\circ p_1)^{-1}F and (f\circ p_2)^{-1}F agree under the unit-compatible inverse-image composition comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] and the equality f\circ p_1=f\circ p_2. Pullback sections are evaluated at the identity etale object, using the canonical terminal-object pullback lift. This assertion requires neither flatness nor quasi-compactness and makes no assertion that the section descends.

source.place: Tag 0A3H (lemma-sections-upstairs), final paragraph, compatibility before fpqc descent; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A3H

proof.text: For a point s of S, put Omega = AlgebraicClosure(kappa(s)), q : Spec Omega -> S, U = T times_S Spec Omega, p : U -> T and h : U -> Spec Omega. Restrict a to U using the inverse-image unit. The equality p followed by f = h followed by q and the unit-compatible composition comparisons identify that restriction with a section of (h followed by q)^-1 F. By the bijectivity clause of etaleGeometricFibreConstantSections, since U is connected, it is the constant section of a unique element e in F_q.

Let D = T times_S T and hD = pr1 followed by f. Pullback universality identifies D times_S Spec Omega with U times_(Spec Omega) U: its two maps to U are obtained by pairing each map to T with the common map to Spec Omega, and the inverse pairs the maps to T with the base point. Restrict each displayed section to this product fibre. Naturality of the inverse-image units and associativity of the composition comparisons identify it with the corresponding pullback of the restriction in Step 1. The naturality clause of etaleGeometricFibreConstantSections then identifies both with the constant section having value e. No connectedness of this product fibre is needed.

Take a geometric point z : Spec K -> D and let s be its image in S. The residue-field description of the composite Spec K -> S gives kappa(s) -> K. Since K is algebraically closed, extend it to an embedding Omega -> K from the chosen algebraic closure. The resulting Spec K -> Spec Omega and z have equal composites to S; their pullback lift is a geometric point of D times_S Spec Omega. The germ equation and bijectivity of etaleSetInverseImageStalkGerm transport the equality from Step 2 at this lift back to equality of the two germs on D. This transport respects the pullback-condition cast because the section comparisons preserve units. Applying etaleSetSection_ext_of_geometric_germs at the identity etale object proves the displayed equality. In the empty-base case D is empty and the same germ-ext statement uses the empty covering.

    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : T ⟶ S)
    (hconn : ∀ s : S, ConnectedSpace
      (pullback f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (S.residueField s) (AlgebraicClosure (S.residueField s)))) ≫
            S.fromSpecResidueField s) : Scheme.{u}))
    (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (a : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj F).obj.obj
      (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 T)))) :
      ((Classical.choose etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits.2.2
          S T (pullback f f) f (pullback.fst f f)).hom.app F).hom.app
        (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (pullback f f))))
        (((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (pullback.fst f f)).obj
            ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj F)).obj.map
          (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk
            (pullback.lift (pullback.fst f f) (𝟙 (pullback f f))
              ((Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm))
            (by simp) :
            Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (pullback f f)) ⟶
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (pullback.fst f f)).obj
                (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 T))).op
          (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (pullback.fst f f)) _
            (T.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            ((pullback f f).smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app
              ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj F)).hom.app
            (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 T))) a)) =
        Eq.mp (congrArg (fun k : pullback f f ⟶ S ↦
          ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj F).obj.obj
            (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (pullback f f)))))
          (pullback.condition (f := f) (g := f)).symm)
        (((Classical.choose etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits.2.2
            S T (pullback f f) f (pullback.snd f f)).hom.app F).hom.app
          (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (pullback f f))))
          (((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (pullback.snd f f)).obj
              ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj F)).obj.map
            (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk
              (pullback.lift (pullback.snd f f) (𝟙 (pullback f f))
                ((Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm))
              (by simp) :
              Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (pullback f f)) ⟶
                (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (pullback.snd f f)).obj
                  (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 T))).op
            (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (pullback.snd f f)) _
              (T.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
              ((pullback f f).smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app
                ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj F)).hom.app
              (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 T))) a)))
